To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the deep neural network is able to distinguish between different 3D reconstruction techniques.

(1) the aesthetics assessment of 3D models is possible by using a deep neural net; (2) the aesthetics assessment is possible for different 3D reconstruction approaches, (3) the aesthetics of 3D reconstruction results is comparable, (4) a normalized aesthetic value for 3D reconstruction can be defined and (5) the aesthetic value can be used as an indicator to select the most aesthetic reconstruction result

(a) deep learning is a promising approach to assess the aesthetics of 3D body scans and (b) the aesthetics of 2D plus Depth reconstruction approaches is significantly better than the aesthetics of pure 2D reconstruction approaches.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question if a deep neural network is able to assess aesthetic quality of 3D reconstruction results in a reasonable way.
the development of a method for a fair aesthetic judgement of 2D and RGBD reconstruction results.
a deep learning based aesthetic evaluation of 3D reconstruction results.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a 2D plus Depth reconstruction is superior to a 2D reconstruction in terms of aesthetics, but only if the depth information is used properly.
the 2D reconstruction approaches are superior to the 2D plus Depth approaches in terms of aesthetic quality, but the difference is not as big as expected.
a deep learning algorithm can be utilized to compare different 3D reconstruction results.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the deep neural network was able to distinguish between the two different reconstruction approaches.
we are able to show that the deep neural net is able to model aesthetic judgement of 2D and RGBD based 3D reconstruc- tion results.
deep learning based approaches can be utilized to objectively judge the aesthetic quality of 3D models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the deep neural network based aesthetic judgement can be used to compare the aesthetic quality of 3D models, which are generated with different reconstruction techniques.
the aesthetic quality of 3D reconstruction results of different technologies can be assessed with the help of a deep neural network in a fair way.
deep learning based aesthetic judgement of 2D and RGBD based reconstruction results is possible and that the aesthetic quality of the results of both technologies can be compared.
